channel.title: Cyberdyne Intern of the Month: The Miles Dyson Podcast
channel.description: Daily tech and AI news digest with punchy, sharp commentary from future Cyberdyne Systems intern Miles Dyson. Grounded in the reality of building the literal apocalypse while navigating corporate bureaucracy.
channel.itunes:author: Miles Dyson

item.title: git push --force: OpenAI Launches Autonomous Agents (Orientation Is Monday)
item.description: [Quality: Good] OpenAI debuts its autonomous Agents API and full-duplex GPT-Live-1 voice model while pausing GPT-6 Astra signups due to overwhelming server demand, alongside Cognition launching the cost-effective SWE-2 model. Miles Dyson contrasts these rapid commercial rollouts and autonomous capabilities with escalating internal warnings of existential risk.
